params.message:
One live insight; pattern-lane quality snapshots; an honest classify log

live-insight.mjs holds the rule the economy already used: not superseded, and draft,
reviewed or published. The Studio's stat, its story starters and the system map
excluded only 'archived', a status no row has, and counted 6,530 lapsed insights as
live (10,396 against 3,866). The citation picker and the evidence search now use the
same rule instead of their own list.

suggest declared critique inside the try that set it, so the quality snapshot after
it threw into an empty catch: no pattern-driven insight got a snapshot since 2 April.

classify logged 'Injecting N feedback examples' while nothing was injected; it now
says the examples are available and not injected, and why.
